title: How Vic Giurgiu validated and built Affistash, an AI affiliate recruitment tool
summary: Vic, a 17-year-old founder and ex-agency owner, explains how he validated Affistash by calling affiliate managers before writing code, then automated the manual partner-discovery work with AI. He shares early-founder lessons on idea validation, mentors, mockups and picking a niche you enjoy.

principles.text: Validate the idea with real people before you build anything.
principles.quote: I always like validating a product and an idea before starting to build it

principles.text: Find the product by asking target users to walk through their whole process, then automate the manual steps.
principles.quote: I figured out that okay there's certainly something that can be done in the recruitment aspect and in the part lead Discovery aspect because it seems like everything is so manual

principles.text: Source validation conversations directly from communities, subreddits and LinkedIn with a plain, honest outreach message.
principles.quote: I reached out to people in in uh affiliate marketing communities in affiliate marketing subreddits on LinkedIn I searched for affiliate managers and so on and I just texted them

principles.text: Use a cheap mockup or low-level demo to get feedback from 10-20 people before building.
principles.quote: I like to create a mockup or a a really lowlevel demo even some something in in canva or figma you don't have to be a pro designer or developer

principles.text: Build a network of influential people and keep a few mentors for big decisions; young founders can reach them more easily than expected.
principles.quote: I have my my two three mentors that I certainly always speak to before jumping in a new venture or uh having an important uh business decision

principles.text: Pick a niche you are passionate about, because it keeps you motivated through the hard times.
principles.quote: pick a niche that that you like a niche that you're passionate about um because that will definitely keep you motivated
